name: Adolf Brudes
features: fair skin, dark hair receding at the temples, narrow eyes, long lean weathered face, slight wiry build, dry humorous expression
bio: Racing motorcycles from 1919 and cars from 1928, mostly up hills, Brudes set a 102 mph two-wheel record in 1926 and never really stopped afterwards. He was fourth overall and second in class at the 1938 Spa 24 Hours in a BMW 328 and third in the 1940 Mille Miglia, started the 1952 German Grand Prix at 52 years old, and was still entering hillclimbs in 1968, forty-nine years after he began.
